contentPattern.structure: search + tag-filter tabs + responsive post-card grid + pagination

suitableFor: blog/article listing pages with searchable, tag-filterable, paginated post grids
resource/insight index pages driven by a list of posts
notSuitableFor: single article detail pages (use blog-detail content)

authoredModel.note: One block row per post. Cell order: image | title | summary | tags (comma-separated) | author | date | link (/blog/{slug}). Interactive search/tag-filter/pagination behavior is added by the block JS at runtime; tag tabs and counts are derived from the authored rows.
